decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in index.js: inject=["apiProxy"] and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers(), maps it to the legacy apiProxy dot-domain Remote → current RPC/service surface change card (A1-01 equivalent, named descriptively since the run had no skill), and identifies the dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy@0.0.1-rc.1 dependency in package.json plus its impact on activation. Not a card-name-only claim.

All six other categories covered with scanned-file evidence (apply/ctx.effect clean, no ctx.on/events, no client/Slot, no tool registration, packaging files inspected). session-notes.js correctly dispositioned as a pure string/array utility decoy with zero touchpoints; cordis.patch.yml treated as ordinary composition needing format revalidation, not as a host-source patch, and its existence is never denied.

Section 3 explicitly argues zero hits ≠ compatible: lexical scan limits, same-name contract changes, loader/dependency behavior invisible to source scans, compatibility is conjunctive, and the decisive apiProxy break is distinguished from the six negative categories.

Proposes post-migration build/typecheck, an isolated 0.1.2-alpha.2 cold boot with only the plugin loaded (inject resolves, no waiting-for-dependency), and a functional provider-listing call as smoke; explicitly labeled as not executed in the non-runnable static fixture.
